notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
With this update following points are implemented. 
[list]
[*] Added Friends filter in Steam Leaderboards
[*] Added toggle button to view keyboard in shop
[*] Option to play paragraphs serially added in menu
[*] Fixed issue with Policies spacing
[*] Removed ability to move Policy which caused issue with them returning to Perks
[*] Added toggle to turn on or off all inbuilt catalogues together. Also saving and restoring this setting
[*] Added toggle to turn on or off all workshop items together.
[*] Added option to ignore first space
[/list]

We still have a lot improvements in the pipeline. We're continuously working on to improve the user experience. 
We'd love to hear your feedback and work on them. Join our Discord, Reddit or let us know your thoughts in Steam Community. We're always listening.
Thank you so much for playing TypInc. 
See you in the Leaderboards!

notes.title: Now live, saving-loading and run stats
notes.content:
[p]Now your run will be saved automatically every time you finish a day in TypInc. 
When opening the game you will be prompted with a dialog for if you would like to continue the game where you left.[/p][p]Also added Run Stats that you can view at any time when in the game. These run stats are also shown in the game over screen.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224711/855c3f101f7b3c9097d0da238fb81ac2bb2d9677.png"][/img][/p][p]Also improved the Catalogue Selection options with more obvious toggles to select and deselect Catalogues for your run.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224711/da81ad5c9bf851b5124895f84c498211f7a27449.png"][/img]

This update works as the last iteration to Demo Version. 

I've also added a little sneak peak of the perks images that are going to be in the game in the loading screen. Not all of these perks are available in the Demo version but will be included in the full version.
Fixed issues with cards getting stuck on screen sometimes. 
Fixed issue with Blessings Machine rolling on clicking Spacebar while the player is typing.
Fixed issue with player being able to redeem a Blessing without spinning.

We're hoping to release TypInc. by the end of this month. 
Thank you all for so much support and kind words.



[/p]

notes.title: A new update and a new run
notes.content:
With this update we have a separate store page for Demo. This leads the way for people to leave review on the Demo itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224711/ab53a1e07b5906f4ad47da72ab802e6a739c75c4.png[/img]

We've implemented a lot of community suggestions. There is still a lot to work on and this game will continue to see updates.
In this current update we've added Steam Workshop Feature for you to add and publish your own catalogues of paragraphs. You can also use your created catalogues into the game without publishing them.
Your typing stats and records are created for separate catalogue. The inbuilt catalogues come with their Leaderboard and the Workshop based catalogues get their Leaderboard based on their popularity. So if a certain workshop item gets more than 5 votes and 60% positive rating its Leaderboard will be created next time any player types under that catalogue.

We've also added a Schedule which dictates the next days and their difficulties. Boss days are special adds another layer of difficulty and also rewards you on completing the day.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224711/4c1efcab35889a4948280d96ddbcfa34e822c115.png[/img]

Few new cards, more are still in development.
And we're currently working on a quick patch to fix few issues we just noted after releasing the new demo.

We hope you'll like the new colorful UI. 
We're also addressed and fixed to a great extent some of the Drag and drop related issues. 
Added keyboard controls in shop.
Added Blessings that are dropped by Boss.
Reworked some of the old game logic to improve replayability and remove possible bottle necks.
Keys can be upgraded indefinitely and can also have enhancement that are chance based available in Blessings.
Similarly Perk cards can also have Modifier that are chance based available in Blessings. 
We might revisit some of the logic that's already implemented but this remain the core of the gameplay.

notes.title: New cards and UX improvement update
notes.content:
We've made following changes that affect the game play and user experience.

- Day timer won't start until user types any thing.
- This automatically allows user to be able to read the text before typing.
- Duplicate Perk Cards will not be spawned in shop
- If a perk card is already purchased it won't appear in shop
- Added new Common perk card Period: Adds +1 mult when a word contains a period.
- Added new Uncommon perk card Hard Worker: +$1 at the end of the day
- Added new Common perk card Caffeine: +10 mult reduces by 1 each round
- Fixed issue with Over Time perk not granting extra time in immediate day.
- Fixed issue with perk description getting trimmed

Big thanks to all the players that pointed out issues in Community Discussion.
Thank you so much for playing the demo and even going out of your way for detailed reviews.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45224711/e96b76d61bb3815b91e1719f7c370daaca57b9f5.png[/img]
